description: Blocked Florida FDACS retail-food record connector with offline injected-fixture lifecycle verification only; native source access and production dispatch are disabled.
redirect_policy: No network transport exists in this implementation. Native URLs, redirects, and provider requests are rejected by the offline-only entry point.
retry: No retries. Fixture, schema, integrity, budget, cancellation, and publication faults terminate the run with durable unpublished evidence.
checkpoint: Persist intent and policy before fixture use, then append immutable lifecycle-stage receipts and fixture-response artifacts under one UUID run. Publish manifest last after offline verification.
idempotency: Each invocation creates a new UUID evidence run. The manifest binds every synthetic input/output checksum; it never updates a current dataset pointer.
cancellation: Abort cooperatively between every fixture read, row page, stage receipt, and publication step. A cancelled run retains failure evidence and never publishes a manifest.
retention_profile: Retain synthetic internal engineering evidence only. No provider rows, production release, current pointer, or public export is permitted.
